title: Geodesic simplices of pseudo-hyperbolic space
summary: We give a cohomological interpretation of the geodesic simplices of the pseudo-hyperbolic space of signature $(p,q)$ and formulate a necessary and sufficient condition for such a simplex to have finite volume. As a corollary, we obtain that every ideal geodesic polytope in the pseudo-hyperbolic space of signature $(2,2)$ has finite volume.
